data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for installing Android packages from APK files.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that uses the native Android Package Installer to install applications directly from an APK file. It returns a status code representing the installation outcome and requires a minimum API level of 21.
use_when: You need to install APK files programmatically within an Android app
You are building a custom in-app updater or app store client for Android
avoid_when: You are targeting iOS or platforms other than Android
You want a fully managed store distribution update without manual APK management
strengths: Direct integration with the Android Package Installer
Provides status codes for installation results
weaknesses: Requires manual native configuration (permissions, FileProvider, XML paths)
data.setup_notes: Requires adding permissions (REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES, READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) to AndroidManifest.xml, setting up an intent filter, configuring a FileProvider, and creating a file_paths.xml resource.
